# Parameter and shape audit (arithmetic only)

*Generated by `scripts/audit_parameters.py` from `src/ansg/utils/parameter_audit.py`. No model was downloaded or run. 'public' = documented configuration of a public checkpoint, not a thesis claim. Conflict ids refer to `SPECIFICATION_CONFLICTS.md`.*

## 1. CSAM head size: `hidden_size // 12` (App. A.25, line 22)

| Backbone | hidden | layers | native heads | head_dim = hidden // 12 | remainder | divides? | source |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- | --- |
| gpt2 (small) | 768 | 12 | 12 | 64 | 0 | yes | public; matches Ch.4 §4.4.1/§4.6.1 arithmetic (d=768, 12 layers) |
| gpt2-medium | 1024 | 24 | 16 | 85 | 4 | **no** | public; named in Ch.4 §4.1.6 |
| gpt2-large | 1280 | 36 | 20 | 106 | 8 | **no** | public; 774M = Ch.5 Table 5.1 base size |
| aubmindlab/aragpt2-large | 1280 | 36 | 20 | 106 | 8 | **no** | hidden/heads from App. A.3 Listing A.2; 36 layers public |

Only d = 768 gives d_k = 64 (the d_k stated in §4.3.6) with 12 heads. With A.3's hidden size 1280 the 12 heads cover 12 × 106 = 1,272 of 1,280 dimensions; a reshape to (12, 106) would fail. The excerpt's helper `compute_multihead_attention` is undefined, so its actual behaviour cannot be determined (C-CSAM-7).

None of the computable components reproduces 16M or 73M; the A.25 excerpt accounts for ≈ 2.77M at hidden 1280. H_i and R_i are recomputed per input from S_active (Eq. 4.12) — §4.6.1 counts them as memory (6,291,456 floats at n = 512), so they cannot themselves be the 16M stored parameters (C-MODEL-2, C-CSAM-2).

## 4. CSAM output combination

App. A.25 returns 0.370·h + 0.347·heritage + 0.283·rhetorical; the coefficients sum to 1.000 (a convex combination of hidden states). Eq. 4.9 instead adds β·H_i + γ·R_i to pre-softmax attention logits; α = 0.370 does not appear in Ch.4 (C-CSAM-4).
